capabilities: Preview the current note in built-in WeChat article layout styles
Generate cover images and inline illustrations from article content
Regenerate or delete individual generated images with adjustable style options
Create drafts in the WeChat Official Account draft box via the WeChat API
Configure LLM and image generation providers and account credentials
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.6.0+. Without WeChat credentials it still works for preview and image generation. It only creates drafts; it does not publish or mass-send articles. Manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Writers drafting WeChat Official Account articles in Obsidian have no way to preview WeChat typesetting, generate matching illustrations, or push drafts to the WeChat backend without manual work.

requires.name: LLM and image generation model configuration
WeChat Official Account AppID and AppSecret

summary: WeChat Official Account publishing assistant that previews notes in WeChat article styles, generates cover and inline images, and creates WeChat drafts.
